name: Psychology Today
one_liner: The largest therapist directory with 400,000+ provider profiles. $29.95/month gets you a searchable listing that patients use to find care.
short_description: Psychology Today is the largest online therapist directory. A profile listing connects therapists with patients searching for mental health providers by location, specialty, and insurance.
long_description: Psychology Today is the dominant therapist directory in North America, with over 400,000 provider profiles and millions of monthly patient searches. For $29.95/month, therapists get a searchable profile listing that includes specialty areas, treatment approaches, insurance accepted, photos, and a personal statement. The platform generates significant patient acquisition—many solo practitioners report 30-50% of new clients come from their Psychology Today listing. Profiles can be enhanced with articles, videos, and verified credentials. The directory supports filtering by insurance, specialty, telehealth availability, and demographics. Psychology Today also offers a patient messaging system for initial contact.
best_for: Therapists accepting insurance who want to be found
Clinicians wanting a simple, low-cost marketing channel
not_for: Practices with full caseloads not taking new clients
Clinicians who only accept referrals from other providers
Large group practices with dedicated marketing teams

pricing.notes: Billed monthly. Annual billing may offer discount.

compliance.notes: Directory listing service. Initial patient contact only—no PHI exchange.

faqs.q: How much does Psychology Today cost?
faqs.a: Psychology Today profiles cost $29.95 per month for a searchable listing in their therapist directory.

faqs.q: Is Psychology Today worth it for therapists?
faqs.a: For most solo practitioners and small practices, yes. Many therapists report 30-50% of new clients finding them through Psychology Today. At $30/month, even one new client makes it worthwhile.

company_info.notes: Psychology Today has been the dominant therapist directory since the 1990s, with the largest provider network.
